rule_0.statement: The parameterized macaque quadruped possesses a NON-EMPTY viability window: (fore share s in [0.25,0.65] step 0.05) x (forepaw cranial reach l = 0.1507 m x {0.70..1.30}) grid points with hindlimb worst demand/cap <= 0.85 AND forelimb elbow demand/cap <= 1.0 under the muscle-derived forelimb caps.

method.machinery: imports the share lane's own derive_quadruped_share.py (statics, ratios, bands, plant solver); the fore plant solve is re-run with the paw-tip target shifted cranially by the commanded reach l; at l=0 it reproduces the banked fore_plant exactly (phi=0.40: a=-0.312, b=+1.062, internal 1.768 rad, miss 78.65 mm)

method.doc_reach_value: l_doc = 0.1507 m, assembly doc sec 3.3 'the walking pose's 0.1507 m paw offset'; the doc tenability bound l <= 0.110 m (= 3.76/34.18) sits between the -30% (0.1055) and -20% (0.1206) points
method.fore_masses: admitted hind-proportion derivation, unchanged (humerus 0.2737 kg @ 0.125 m, forearm 0.1323 kg @ 0.132 m)
method.elbow_demand_sign: flexion-demand = sign(b-a) x tau_elbow; at every grid point it is positive (the load folds the elbow) so the EXTENSOR side of the admitted envelope holds it - the triceps side, as quadrupedal support demands

task1_caps.statement: the store admits NO forelimb PCSA: the Guimaraes 2026 architecture batch is hindlimb-only (30 M. mulatta muscles); the arm model records carry max_isometric_force (39/39), fiber lengths and pennation but no PCSA row
task1_caps.route: cap = SUM_i PCSA_i x sigma x r_i with PCSA_i = Fmax_i/sigma (sigma cancels) = SUM_i Fmax_i x r_i on the matching envelope side; Fmax admitted (limblab arm model @ 4fb7ddee), moment arms admitted (muscle-path lane, falsifier HELD at 4.3e-10 m worst straight-path, fd authoritative on the one active wrap)
task1_caps.sigma_documentation: 0.30 MPa literature standard, the run's single external constant, used ONLY for the implied-PCSA column; inside the in-repo reference band 25-32 N/cm2 (docs/research/muscle_physiology_reference.md); the in-repo derived hindlimb slope 1.281 MPa (published group spread 0.31-5.29 MPa) is recorded but not used as primary (hindlimb fit)
task1_caps.pose_caveat: admitted arms exist only at neutral (elbow internal 1.571 rad) and the walking surrogate (1.745 rad, the flexed edge of the quadruped band 1.75-2.44); arms in the straighter half of the band are NOT admitted; neutral bracket reported alongside

F_window_nonempty_at_admitted_parameters.detail: 28 of 63 grid points viable under the muscle-derived caps; the window is a band: s >= 0.50 (hind criterion) across the whole +/-30% reach sweep (elbow criterion slack everywhere in it, worst 0.689)

F_elbow_monotone.detail: FIRED: max demand decrease 0.079 N.m (> 1e-3 tolerance) at fixed s between l=0.166 and l=0.181. Diagnosis (measured, in viability_window.json): demand = (s*W/2) x ACHIEVED lever + arm self-weight; the achieved lever is band-limited - through l=0.105-0.166 the forearm angle pins at the B_BAND edge (+1.200 rad) with lever EXACTLY 123.0 mm (piecewise-constant demand on the solver's discrete pose lattice); at l~0.18 the plant switches branch (elbow cranially inverted, internal angle to the INT_BAND top) shortening the binding lever to 120.6 mm. R x lever closes on the demand to the 0.064 N.m self-weight intercept at every point: real statics of the band-constrained plant, not a solver fault. The monotone-in-COMMANDED-l proposition is RETRACTED; the grid rows stand as self-contained static solves; the window verdict rests on F_window, which is independent.

honest_summary: The quadruped as parameterized HAS a viable static share window, but only under the muscle-derived forelimb caps and only at high fore share: hind worst <= 0.85 needs s >= 0.50, and at s in [0.50, 0.65] the fore elbow runs at 0.53-0.69 of the 5.80 N.m extensor cap across the entire +/-30% reach sweep - the cranial boundary is the posture band (achieved lever saturates at 123 mm), not the muscle cap, exactly as predicted. The caps question is decisive, as predicted: under the predecessor's segment-scaled cap (2.368 N.m, no muscle anchoring - implied 5.12 mm extensor arm vs 12.6-13.5 mm measured) the same grid has an EMPTY window, and under the doc's 3.76 N.m anchor the window shrinks to s in [0.50, 0.60]. The store carries no forelimb PCSA (Guimaraes is hindlimb-only); the caps were derived from the admitted arm-model forces x the admitted derived moment arms with sigma = 0.30 MPa documented as the single external constant (it cancels in the cap algebra). One falsifier fired and is banked as fired: elbow demand is NOT monotone in the commanded reach - the band-constrained plant switches branch at l~0.18; the diagnosis exonerates the machinery (R x lever closes at every point) and kills only the monotonicity proposition, which is retracted. The theta* track (diagnostic only) is non-monotone in s (0.96-1.25), the share lane's known pose-selection effect: the fixed-pose track remains the falsifier track, and on it even the viable corner leaves the hindlimb at 0.83 of cap - the quadruped buys its viability with a fore-heavy 50/50-or-more share, near the fore-dominant 69/31 the assembly doc derived, and far from any bipedal s=0.
